title: Unspaced closure signatures inside an array shape

ground_truth.statement: Removing spaces between shape keys and closure signatures does not change the callable shape. Required callback a can return an integer map or null.

provenance.note: Full dataset read. Removed the false [] @var initializer; kept nested optional closure syntax in a real parameter contract.

notes: Same criterion as the spaced variant; two parser fixtures do not count as two semantic criteria.
